no_api_findings.finding: The documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library has no XML parser, tokenizer, or namespace resolver. The all-items page (rustdoc 1.99.1 58cf8f9c3) lists no item whose name contains 'xml'; its only 'xml' text is the favicon MIME type image/svg+xml. std::str::from_utf8 and std::io::Read validate or return bytes without interpreting markup. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against controls/xml/catalog-ns.xml.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library (core, alloc, std). External crates, rustc-internal crates, and native system libraries are separate. The finding is not yet merged into an aggregate standard inventory, which does not know the xml format.
